title: Treats over tricks: How to spot frightening uniform service problems
summary: Avoid tricks in your uniform service this Halloween. This seasonal guide uncovers common commercial laundering issues and how to fix them.
body_markdown:
Managing an active employee uniform service shouldn’t be scary. This article highlights the most common “tricks” hidden inside the commercial laundering industry, from vanishing garments to mystery fees, and outlines how a transparent, customer-first service provider turns those operational headaches into daily treats.


## Table of Contents


Halloween is the perfect time of year to throw on a costume and pretend to be a chef, a technician, or a first responder for the night. But for millions of hard-working people, those uniforms are real-life daily equipment. And if your business is tied to the wrong provider, trying to manage that uniform program on your own can quickly turn into a total nightmare.


Not all uniform service providers operate with the same high standards. Some prefer to rely on frustrating tricks all year long, not just in October. Here is a breakdown of the most common workplace workwear scares, and exactly what a reputable partner does to keep them away.


## The case of the disappearing workwear


If you turn in a specific stack of[work shirts](https://unifirst.com/uniforms-workwear/work-shirts/) at the end of the week, you expect that exact same count to land back on your delivery rack the following week. Unfortunately, disappearing garments are one of the most frequent tricks played on business owners. It is an easy way for an unreliable vendor to hit you with unexpected replacement charges for inventory that seemingly vanished into thin air.


###### How to avoid the scare


[Partner with a company](https://unifirst.com/uniform-rental-company/) that uses advanced electronic garment tracking. By scanning every piece of apparel in and out of the facility, your provider gives you full, continuous visibility over your inventory, eliminating the blame game and protecting your budget.


## Mystery damage fees


Do random repair surcharges pop up on your weekly bill without warning? Getting charged for a ripped seam or a stained pair of pants without ever seeing the proof is a major red flag. This trick quietly inflates your overall spend while leaving you with no way to verify the damage or prevent it from happening again.


###### How to avoid the scare


Never accept a damage fee if your provider cannot physically show you the garment in question. A trustworthy uniform service partner values transparency and will always bring the specific item to your attention so you know exactly what you are paying for.


## Nightmare invoices


Your weekly service bill should never look like a complex puzzle that requires a team of mad scientists to decipher.[If your costs are constantly fluctuating](https://unifirst.com/blog/procurement-strategy-and-tail-spend/) and unexplained fees keep appearing out of nowhere, your provider might be trying to make the invoice intentionally confusing, so you simply stop asking questions.


###### How to avoid the scare


Take control of your operational budget before it gets out of hand. A reliable service partner provides transparent, predictable, and easy-to-read billing. By logging into the[UniFirst Portal](https://unifirst.com/blog/the-unifirst-portal-a-game-changer-for-your-uniform-rental-program/) , you get transparency into your invoices at any time. You can review past billing cycles, audit your current inventory costs, and verify charges instantly, removing the mystery and putting you back in the driver's seat of your expenses.


## The phantom account representative


We have all dealt with it: a representative who seems perfectly pleasant when you first meet them but completely vanishes the moment you actually need a problem solved. If your phone calls go unanswered and your requests disappear down a black hole, you are dealing with a phantom account.


###### How to avoid the scare


You shouldn’t have to hunt down support. A dedicated uniform program should be backed by a responsive, transparent (but not like a ghost) route service team that shows up consistently. A reliable partner supports their field team with a 24/7 digital platform like the[UniFirst Portal](https://unifirst.com/customer-portal/) . This puts total operational control back into your hands, giving you instant access to submit service requests, manage wearers, and track replacements the exact minute you need them, without waiting for a phone call back.
